Callout.Name: Counter-Terrorism Raid
Callout.Message: Warrant to be executed at an address under investigation.
Callout.Advisory: Occupants believed armed, property covered front and rear.

Script.Line: You have got the wrong address.
I have lived here eleven years. Ask anybody on the street.
The back door. He has gone out of the back door.

Stages.Stage: Both doors covered. Entry when you are ready.
One has come out of the back with something in hand.
Address secure. Evidence teams going in.

Lines.Approach: Both doors are covered and the warrant is in my hand. Entry on your word.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
